filing_fee_notes: Base formation fee is 100; paper submissions add 20 manual processing, totaling 120. Name reservation is 20 base or 40 with paper processing.
registered_agent_rules: Maintain an Idaho registered agent with a physical Idaho address. An owner may serve if the address requirement is met.
standard_processing_time: The Secretary of State currently posts approximately 3-5 days from filing; this is a changing queue estimate.
plain_english_summary: File a Certificate of Organization through SOSBiz. Keep the agent information current and file annual reports.
common_mistake: Mailing formation documents without the additional manual-processing fee.
notes: Domestic LLC scope. Annual-report fee and exact due-date rule were not confirmed on the permitted official sources reviewed and are null. LLC-specific expedite options, franchise/privilege tax, publication and operating-agreement requirement were also not confirmed and are null.
